claim: The IEA estimated (2026) that data-centre electricity consumption grew 17% to about 485 TWh in 2025 and projected it to roughly double to about 950 TWh by 2030, around 3% of global electricity demand.
evidence: "The global electricity demand of data centres – the critical infrastructure for training and running AI models – grew by 17% in 2025, in line with IEA projections."; "Our updated projections see electricity consumption from data centres roughly doubling from 485 TWh in 2025 to 950 TWh in 2030, accounting for around 3% of global electricity demand by that date." (IEA, Key Questions on Energy and AI, Executive summary)

metric.name: Data-centre electricity consumption
metric.methodology: IEA estimate; 2030 figure is IEA central projection (950 TWh)
